messages:
Tara Singh: Quick note : running a calibration dry-run this week for managers to test the new rubric + anonymized ballot UI. Looking for 10 volunteers to run a small batch (3 anonymized reviews each) and give quick feedback within 48h.

Elliot Moore: Thanks Tara. Are these live employee records or synthetic examples? Want to be careful with PHI.

Tara Singh: Good question. Using anonymized exports only (names removed, IDs hashed). No PHI. Export docs here: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/dry-run.

Hannah Li: If I volunteer, will my calibration votes count toward the actual calibration?

People Ops Bot: note: Dry-run votes are NOT included in official calibration tallies. This is a test environment for feedback only. Results are ephemeral and used for UX/rubric tweaks.

Tara Singh: Time ask is ~30-45m: 3 reviews + 5-10m feedback form. Well ship a one-page rubric summary and a short how-to gif. Please sign up by EOD Wednesday.

Elliot Moore: Can managers pick sample difficulty (easy/med/high)? My org wants to see high-effort cases.

Tara Singh: Yes well tag samples by effort. Add a preference on the signup form and well try to match. Signup link: https://forms.redwood.com/calibration-dryrun-signup.

Hannah Li: Any CSV template for bulk signups from managers who want multiple reps?

Tara Singh: Yep, quick CSV for coordinators:```csv
manager_email,num_volunteers,preferred_effort,notes
tara.singh@redwood.ai,2,high,include one edge-case
```

People Ops Bot: reminder: Feedback form after dry-run: https://forms.redwood.com/calibration-dryrun-feedback. Well aggregate suggestions and open a short office hour for rubric Q&A.

Tara Singh: Appreciate any volunteers. If you sign up, expect assignment and package (samples + rubric PDF) within 6-12h. Ping me here for questions or to request specific sample types. :sparkles:
